comparators.assumption: Original base query only, with no experimental task/state constraints. Calls Organization.search directly.
User already knows a discriminative basename for each desired representation; this knowledge is not charged as a retrieval step.
User knows each authorized immediate parent folder. Selection among names is label-assisted, as in policy navigation; no recursive scan, filesystem search or Finder interaction occurs.
